name: Appointments: Availability

description.en: Collect booking details and return appointment availability from the current agent calendar.
description.de: Sammelt Buchungsdetails und liefert Terminverfuegbarkeit aus dem Kalender des aktuellen Agenten.
description.fr: Collectez les details de reservation et recuperez les disponibilites depuis le calendrier de l agent actuel.
description.es: Recoge los datos de la reserva y devuelve la disponibilidad desde el calendario del agente actual.
description.ro: Colecteaza detaliile rezervarii si intoarce disponibilitatea din calendarul agentului curent.
description.it: Collect booking details and return appointment availability from the current agent calendar.

bot: REQUIRED first step for any appointment booking. Do not create calendar events directly; that bypasses availability checks, policy rules, and attendee tracking. Collect purpose, preferred time, timezone, and the attendee contact. Convert relative dates to exact ISO datetimes with an explicit year (use the current year/next occurrence — never a past year). If the user agrees on a specific time (e.g. 'Wednesday Oct 7 at 11:00'), set windowStart to that exact datetime and windowEnd to start + durationMinutes — do NOT expand to a full day or next-day midnight. Only use a broad day/range window when the user is still flexible. Prefer contactId from CRM (find-or-create / list contacts first); use attendeeName only as a fallback when no contact exists yet.

inputs.name: Appointment Title
inputs.bot: Short title describing the appointment, such as 'Intro Call', 'Product Demo', or 'Support Session'.

inputs.name: Window Start

description.en: The earliest acceptable start time in ISO format
description.de: Die frueheste moegliche Startzeit im ISO-Format
description.fr: Heure de debut la plus tot acceptable au format ISO
description.es: Hora mas temprana aceptable en formato ISO
description.ro: Cea mai devreme ora acceptata de inceput in format ISO
description.it: The earliest acceptable start time in ISO format

inputs.bot: Earliest acceptable appointment start in ISO 8601 with time of day (never date-only / midnight unless the user said 'anytime that day'). For an agreed slot like 11:00, use that exact time, e.g. 2026-10-07T11:00:00+02:00. Verify the weekday matches the date.

inputs.name: Window End

description.en: The latest acceptable end of the scheduling window in ISO format
description.de: Das spaeteste Ende des Zeitfensters im ISO-Format
description.fr: Heure de fin la plus tardive acceptable pour le creneau au format ISO
description.es: Fin mas tardio aceptable de la franja horaria en formato ISO
description.ro: Cel mai tarziu sfarsit acceptat al intervalului in format ISO
description.it: The latest acceptable end of the scheduling window in ISO format

inputs.bot: End of the acceptable scheduling window in ISO 8601 with time of day. For an agreed slot, set this to windowStart + durationMinutes (e.g. 11:00 start / 30 min → 11:30 same day). Do not push end to the next calendar day unless the user asked for a multi-day search window.

inputs.name: Duration Minutes

description.es: Duracion de la cita en minutos

inputs.bot: Meeting duration in minutes. Use 30 unless the user asks for a different length.

inputs.name: Contact ID

description.en: CRM contact ID for the attendee
description.fr: ID du contact CRM du participant
description.es: ID del contacto CRM del asistente
description.it: CRM contact ID for the attendee

inputs.bot: Preferred. Pass the existing CRM contact hashid for the attendee. Resolve via contact find-or-create / list before inventing a free-text name. Never create a duplicate contact.

inputs.name: Attendee Name

description.fr: Nom du participant ou du demandeur
description.es: Nombre de la persona asistente o solicitante

inputs.bot: Fallback only when contactId is unavailable. Prefer contactId.

inputs.name: Attendee Email

description.fr: E-mail du participant ou du demandeur
description.es: Correo de la persona asistente o solicitante

inputs.bot: Optional if contactId is set (email comes from the contact). Otherwise pass when known.

inputs.name: Notes

description.fr: Notes ou ordre du jour facultatifs

inputs.bot: Optional notes, context, or agenda for the appointment.

description.it: Give us a quick idea of the purpose.

description.de: Wähle ein Zeitfenster und wir finden den besten Slot.
description.fr: Choisissez un creneau et nous trouverons le meilleur horaire.
description.es: Elige una franja y encontraremos el mejor hueco.
description.ro: Alege un interval si gasim cel mai bun slot.
description.it: Pick a window and we'll find the best slot.

description.en: So we know who to expect.
